mapper.select: SELECT code, label, display_order, is_custom AS custom FROM training_goal_category ORDER BY display_order, code

SELECT goal.id, goal.category_code, category.label AS category_label, goal.goal_text, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM student_training_goal assigned WHERE assigned.student_id = #{studentId} AND assigned.goal_id = goal.id ) AS assigned FROM training_goal goal JOIN training_goal_category category ON category.code = goal.category_code WHERE goal.goal_type = 'STANDARD'
AND goal.goal_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND goal.category_code = #{categoryCode}
ORDER BY category.display_order, goal.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_goal (category_code, goal_text, goal_type, owner_student_id) VALUES (#{categoryCode}, #{goalText}, #{goalType}, #{ownerStudentId})
INSERT INTO student_training_goal (student_id, goal_id, initial_level, current_level, phase, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{goalId}, #{initialLevel}, #{currentLevel}, #{phase}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT item.id, item.student_id, item.goal_id, goal.goal_type, goal.category_code, category.label AS category_label, goal.goal_text, item.initial_level, item.current_level, item.phase, item.status FROM student_training_goal item JOIN training_goal goal ON goal.id = item.goal_id JOIN training_goal_category category ON category.code = goal.category_code WHERE item.id = #{id} AND item.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_training_goal WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId}
DELETE FROM training_goal WHERE id = #{goalId} AND goal_type = 'CUSTOM' AND owner_student_id = #{studentId}
